paragraphs.zh: 一种环磺酮产品的纯化方法
paragraphs.en: A method for the purification of a tembotrione product
paragraphs.notes: Invention title, printed centred in bold below the header rule. Not a numbered [00NN] paragraph, so marker is null. The title names the compound by its Chinese common name; the page itself supplies the identification with tembotrione in [0002], which prints "(tembotrione)" in Latin letters directly after it.
Bold section heading, not a numbered paragraph. Precedes [0001].

paragraphs.zh: 本发明涉及农药合成领域，具体地讲，涉及一种降低环磺酮产品中的杂质水平的方法。
paragraphs.en: The present invention relates to the field of pesticide synthesis, and specifically relates to a method for reducing the level of impurities in a tembotrione product.
paragraphs.notes: The invention is stated here as a purification / impurity-reduction method, not as a preparation route. This is load-bearing for reading the scheme drawn later on this page.

Bold section heading, not a numbered paragraph. Precedes [0002]. No further section heading is printed anywhere on this page (there is no summary-of-invention heading), so everything from here to the page foot sits inside the background section.

paragraphs.zh: 环磺酮(tembotrione)是三酮类对‑羟苯基丙酮酸双氧化酶(HPPD)抑制类除草剂，HPPD抑制类除草剂因具有活性高、残留低、对哺乳动物安全和对环境友好等特点，成为玉米除草剂市场上炙手可热的产品。环磺酮除草谱广、除草适期长，主要靶标为：玉米田芽后中晚期各种阔叶杂草与禾本科杂草，对蓟草、田旋花、婆婆纳、辣子草、鼬瓣花和猪殃殃等防效优异，且对后茬作物无药害，是美国玉米田最重要的除草剂之一。
paragraphs.en: Tembotrione is a triketone-class para-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase (HPPD) inhibitor herbicide. Because HPPD-inhibitor herbicides have such features as high activity, low residue, safety to mammals and friendliness to the environment, they have become much sought-after products on the maize herbicide market. Tembotrione has a broad weed-control spectrum and a long window of suitable application; its main targets are the various broadleaf weeds and grass weeds of the middle to late post-emergence stage in maize fields. It has excellent efficacy against thistle, field bindweed, speedwell, gallant soldier, splitlip hempnettle, cleavers and the like, and it causes no phytotoxicity to the following crop. It is one of the most important herbicides in maize fields in the United States.
paragraphs.notes: The enzyme name is translated literally as "para-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase": the page writes the para- prefix, whereas the standard English name of HPPD uses the 4-hydroxyphenyl locant, so the literal reading is kept rather than the conventional one. The Chinese word used for the enzyme class means, character for character, "dioxygenase". The text layer emits the U+2011 NON-BREAKING HYPHEN character in that name where the pixels show an ordinary hyphen, and zh carries whatever the text layer emits. The six weeds are given by Chinese common name and are translated to their usual English common names, in the printed order: thistle, field bindweed (Convolvulus arvensis), speedwell (Veronica), gallant soldier (Galinsoga parviflora), splitlip hempnettle (Galeopsis bifida), cleavers (Galium aparine). The last clause refers to the crop that follows in the rotation.

The text layer emits U+2011 NON-BREAKING HYPHEN inside the CAS number and a full-width colon after the label; both are preserved in zh. This registry number is that of tembotrione. Cross-checked against the structure drawn at [0008]: see discrepancies.

paragraphs.zh: 化学性质：白色或类白色无定形粉末，几乎不溶于乙醇，极易溶于二氯甲烷，微溶于甲苯。
paragraphs.en: Chemical properties: a white or off-white amorphous powder, almost insoluble in ethanol, very readily soluble in dichloromethane, slightly soluble in toluene.
paragraphs.notes: The two solubility words are the Chinese Pharmacopoeia-style grades, translated as "very readily soluble" and "slightly soluble" respectively; the page gives no numeric solubilities. The colour term means off-white / almost white.

paragraphs.en: Melting point: 123 (deg C). Its structural formula is (Formula 1):
paragraphs.notes: Printed as one run-on line: the melting point and the announcement of the structural formula share the paragraph with no separating punctuation. The drawing label is the patent's own, translated here as "Formula 1"; it is a single structure, not a reaction scheme. The unit is printed as the single full-width character U+2103 DEGREE CELSIUS inside half-width parentheses, and the trailing colon is full-width; zh preserves both.

Bare paragraph marker: the [0008] label is printed at the left margin with no text of its own. Its printed content is the tembotrione structural formula announced by [0007], an image region carrying no text layer, recorded as drawing 1 in the drawings array and read off the pixels. The centred caption below the structure reads "Formula 1" (printed with a space between the two characters) and is also image-only.

paragraphs.zh: 环磺酮的制备是通过2‑氯‑3‑(2,2,2‑三氟乙氧基)甲基‑4‑甲磺酰基苯甲酸与氯化亚砜反应生成2‑氯‑3‑(2,2,2‑三氟乙氧基)甲基‑4‑甲磺酰基苯甲酰氯，再与环己二酮反应生成烯醇酯，经过丙酮氰醇重排反应最终生成环磺酮(tembotrione)。反应式如下(式2)：
paragraphs.en: Tembotrione is prepared by reacting 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid with thionyl chloride to give 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoyl chloride, which is then reacted with cyclohexanedione to give the enol ester, and which by way of an acetone cyanohydrin rearrangement reaction finally gives tembotrione. The reaction scheme is as follows (Formula 2):
paragraphs.notes: This sentence states how tembotrione is made as established fact, inside the background section, and it is the route the drawing at [0010] shows. The document's own invention is a purification method (see the title and [0001]), so this route is prior art rather than the invention's route. Three stages are named in prose: acid plus thionyl chloride to the acyl chloride; acyl chloride plus cyclohexanedione to the enol ester; acetone cyanohydrin rearrangement to tembotrione. The dione is named WITHOUT a locant here, so the 1,3- assignment is not stated in this paragraph. The rearrangement is translated literally as "acetone cyanohydrin rearrangement reaction"; this paragraph does not say whether the acetone cyanohydrin acts as a catalyst, although [0011] does call it one. The text layer emits U+2011 NON-BREAKING HYPHEN throughout the chemical names, which zh preserves.

Bare paragraph marker: the [0010] label is printed at the left margin with no text of its own. Its printed content is the preparation scheme announced by [0009], an image region carrying no text layer, recorded as drawing 2 in the drawings array and read off the pixels. The scheme is laid out over two rows and the [0010] label is printed at the left margin between them, so the drawing spans the marker. The centred caption below the second row reads "Formula 2" and is also image-only.

paragraphs.zh: 上述经过重排过程生成的生成环磺酮产品，通常会生成催化剂丙酮氰醇以及反应
paragraphs.en: The tembotrione product produced by the above rearrangement process usually also produces the catalyst acetone cyanohydrin as well as reaction
paragraphs.notes: The paragraph is cut off by the page break and continues on the next page; the English is left correspondingly truncated, ending on the same dangling word. The Chinese duplicates the verb "produce" (it reads, literally, "produced by the above rearrangement process, the produced tembotrione product"); it is printed that way and has not been corrected. This is the first place on the page that calls acetone cyanohydrin a catalyst.

drawings.notes: Single standalone structure, no arrow and no reagent label. It is the structural formula of tembotrione itself, announced by [0007] and captioned "Formula 1" below the drawing. presented_as is set to intermediate_structure because that is the schema's only value for a standalone structure; the honest description is that this is an identity drawing of the compound the invention purifies, printed in the background section, and it is NOT an intermediate of any route and NOT a prior-art route. Ring numbering above is read off the drawing geometry: C1 is the benzene vertex bonded to the bridging carbonyl, and the four substituted benzene vertices are CONSECUTIVE (attachment, then Cl, then CH2OCH2CF3, then SO2CH3), leaving the remaining two vertices bare. Both ketones of the carbocycle are drawn as explicit C=O, one up-left and one down-right, each one bond from the substituted C2, so it is the 1,3-dione.

drawings.notes: The prior-art preparation route, announced by [0009] and captioned "Formula 2" below the drawing. PRESENTED AS PRIOR ART, not as the invention's route, on four grounds: the drawing sits inside the background section, whose heading is printed above [0002] with no later heading before it anywhere on this page; [0009] introduces it as how the preparation of tembotrione is done, not as anything the applicant proposes; the invention itself is stated in the title and in [0001] to be a purification / impurity-reduction method rather than a preparation route; and [0011], immediately after the drawing, treats this route's output as the problem to be solved, since it leaves acetone cyanohydrin behind. Layout: two rows, read left to right then down. Row 1 carries the acid, the first arrow, the enol ester and the second arrow; row 2 carries the final product alone. The 2nd and 4th structures are reagents sitting off the reaction line rather than members of the main chain; they are recorded in the structures array so their connectivity is not lost, with their arrow roles given in the arrows array.

discrepancies.what: The prose in [0009] names an acyl chloride intermediate that the drawn scheme never draws: the drawing collapses two of the three prose stages onto a single arrow, putting SOCl2 above that arrow and cyclohexane-1,3-dione below it.
discrepancies.drawing_says: one arrow running from 2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoic acid straight to the enol ester, with reagents SOCl2 above and cyclohexane-1,3-dione below; no acyl chloride structure appears anywhere in the drawing
discrepancies.text_says: [0009] names three stages, with 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoyl chloride as a discrete named product of the thionyl chloride step, then reacted with cyclohexanedione to give the enol ester

discrepancies.what: The prose names the dione without a locant while the drawing fixes it. This is the prose being less specific than the drawing, not a contradiction.
discrepancies.drawing_says: the co-reagent below the first arrow is drawn with its two ring ketones separated by one CH2, i.e. unambiguously cyclohexane-1,3-dione
discrepancies.text_says: [0009] writes the reagent as plain cyclohexanedione with no locant, which on its own would also admit the 1,2- and 1,4-diones

discrepancies.what: The molecular weight printed in [0005] does not match the molecular formula printed in [0004] or the structure drawn at [0008]. Recorded, not corrected.
discrepancies.drawing_says: the structure drawn at [0008] is exactly C17H16ClF3O6S, counted off the drawing as 17 C, 16 H, 1 Cl, 3 F, 6 O, 1 S, whose formula weight is 440.81 on standard atomic weights
discrepancies.text_says: [0005] gives the molecular weight as 440.88, which is 0.07 higher than the formula in [0004] and the drawn structure give

discrepancies.what: NO DISAGREEMENT, cross-check run and passed: the molecular formula in [0004] and the CAS number in [0003] both agree with the structure drawn at [0008].
discrepancies.drawing_says: atom count off the drawing at [0008] is C17 H16 Cl1 F3 O6 S1, and the connectivity drawn is that of tembotrione, CAS 335104-84-2
discrepancies.text_says: [0004] gives the molecular formula as C17H16ClF3O6S and [0003] gives the CAS number as 335104-84-2

discrepancies.what: NO DISAGREEMENT, cross-check run and passed: every reagent drawn on the scheme is also written in the prose, and every reagent written in the prose is also drawn. discrepancies.text_says: [0009] names thionyl chloride, cyclohexanedione and acetone cyanohydrin, and names no other reagent, no base, no solvent and no temperature

discrepancies.what: The structure drawn at [0008] and the final structure of the scheme at [0010] are drawn identically. This is consistent, and is recorded so that a downstream pass does not read them as two different compounds.
